titles.nb: Forskrift om restriktive tiltak vedrørende handlinger som undergraver eller truer Ukrainas territorielle integritet, suverenitet, uavhengighet og stabilitet
titles.en: Regulation on restrictive measures in respect of actions undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty, independence and stability of Ukraine

payload.shortName: Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds and economic resources of persons listed under the Russia and Ukraine sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 3

titles.en: Freeze the funds and economic resources of persons listed under the Russia and Ukraine sanctions

summaries.en: A bank must freeze all funds and economic resources that belong to, or are owned, held or controlled by, the natural and legal persons listed in Annex I of the regulation: those responsible for or supporting actions undermining or threatening Ukraine's territorial integrity, sovereignty and independence, and the further categories § 3 sets out, such as leading Russian businesspersons and those facilitating sanctions circumvention.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds or economic resources available to persons listed under the Russia and Ukraine sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 3

titles.en: Make no funds or economic resources available to persons listed under the Russia and Ukraine sanctions

summaries.en: A bank must not make any funds or economic resources available, directly or indirectly, to or for the benefit of the persons listed in Annex I of the regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen assets and assets moved before a listing to DEKSA within two weeks
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8

titles.en: Report frozen assets and assets moved before a listing to DEKSA within two weeks

summaries.en: Regardless of rules on reporting, confidentiality and professional secrecy, a bank must give Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner (DEKSA) information that facilitates compliance with the freeze no later than two weeks after receiving it: the funds and economic resources it has frozen, or holds for a listed person without treating them as frozen, and those of a listed person that were moved, transferred or used in the two weeks before the listing. Reports on frozen assets identify the owner and give amounts, market values and the form of each asset, and the bank must cooperate with DEKSA in verifying them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze any credit to a frozen account and tell DEKSA at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 7

titles.en: Freeze any credit to a frozen account and tell DEKSA at once

summaries.en: A credit or financial institution may credit a frozen account with funds a third party transfers to a listed person only if the credited amounts are frozen too, and it must inform Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner (DEKSA) of such transactions immediately.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not deal in new securities of, or lend to, the Russian banks and companies listed for financial restrictions
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8b

titles.en: Do not deal in new securities of, or lend to, the Russian banks and companies listed for financial restrictions

summaries.en: A bank must not buy, sell or provide investment services for transferable securities and money-market instruments issued after the cut-off dates by the Russian banks and companies listed in Annexes V, VII, VIII, XIII and XIV, their entities outside Norway and the EU owned more than 50 % by them, or anyone acting for them. Nor may it make, or take part in arrangements to make, new loans or credit to those entities (for any maturity after 19 March 2022), apart from narrow exceptions for financing non-prohibited trade and emergency funding that must be notified within three months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not deal in new Russian sovereign debt, lend to the Russian state or handle the Central Bank of Russia's reserves
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8c

titles.en: Do not deal in new Russian sovereign debt, lend to the Russian state or handle the Central Bank of Russia's reserves

summaries.en: A bank must not buy, sell or provide investment services for transferable securities and money-market instruments issued after 1 April 2022 by Russia, its government or the Central Bank of Russia, nor make new loans or credit to them after 18 March 2022, except documented trade finance or drawdowns under earlier contracts notified to DEKSA within three months. Transactions related to the management of the Central Bank of Russia's reserves and assets are prohibited.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not transact with the Russian state-owned entities listed in Annex XIX
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8ca

titles.en: Do not transact with the Russian state-owned entities listed in Annex XIX

summaries.en: A bank must not take part, directly or indirectly, in any transaction with the Russian state-controlled or majority publicly owned entities listed in Annex XIX, with their entities outside Norway and the EU owned more than 50 % by them, or with anyone acting on their behalf, except where the regulation's exceptions (for example for gas, oil, agricultural products and medicines) apply.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not connect to SPFS or other Central Bank of Russia payment and messaging systems
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8cd

titles.en: Do not connect to SPFS or other Central Bank of Russia payment and messaging systems

summaries.en: A legal person established in Norway must not connect to the Central Bank of Russia's System for Transfer of Financial Messages (SPFS) or equivalent specialised financial messaging services, and from 29 June 2026 to any Central Bank of Russia system, including the Fast Payment System (SBP) and Mir. It must also not transact with the entities outside Russia listed in Annex XLIV for using such services, subject to the regulation's narrow exceptions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not transact with the third-country banks and financial firms listed in Annex XLV
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8ce

titles.en: Do not transact with the third-country banks and financial firms listed in Annex XLV

summaries.en: A bank must not take part, directly or indirectly, in transactions with the credit, financial and crypto-asset firms established outside Norway and the EU that are listed in Annex XLV for supporting Russia's war or sanctions circumvention, with entities acting on their behalf, or with mirror or successor entities, except for the narrow purposes the regulation exempts, such as food, medicines and humanitarian aid.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Russian nationals, residents and entities
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8d

titles.en: Refuse deposits above EUR 100 000 from Russian nationals, residents and entities

summaries.en: A bank must not accept deposits from Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia, legal persons established in Russia or legal persons outside Norway and the EU owned more than 50 % by them if the total value of that depositor's deposits with the bank would exceed EUR 100 000. Nationals of Norway, an EEA state or Switzerland and holders of a temporary or permanent residence permit there are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not provide crypto-asset, payment-instrument or e-money services to Russian nationals, residents and entities
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, Sanksjonsforskrift Ukraina (territoriell integritet mv.) (FOR-2014-08-15-1076) § 8d

titles.en: Do not provide crypto-asset, payment-instrument or e-money services to Russian nationals, residents and entities

summaries.en: A firm must not provide, directly or indirectly, to Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia or legal persons established in Russia any crypto-asset services as defined in Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, the issuing of payment instruments, acquiring of payment transactions or related payment services as defined in Directive (EU) 2015/2366, or the issuing of electronic money. Nationals of Norway, an EEA state or Switzerland and holders of a residence permit there are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not sell NOK- or EU-currency securities issued after the cut-off date to Russian nationals, residents and entities
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, FOR-2022-03-18-410 inserting § 8h in FOR-2014-08-15-1076 (prohibition on selling euro securities issued after 4 May 2022 to Russian persons), read with the current heading of § 8h in the consolidated text (Norwegian kroner or an EU member state's currency)

titles.en: Do not sell NOK- or EU-currency securities issued after the cut-off date to Russian nationals, residents and entities

summaries.en: A bank must not sell to Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia or legal persons established in Russia transferable securities denominated in Norwegian kroner or an official currency of an EU member state issued after the cut-off date the section sets, or units in collective investment undertakings giving exposure to such securities. As introduced in March 2022 the ban covered euro-denominated securities issued after 4 May 2022.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Russian nationals, residents and entities to DEKSA every twelve months
obligations.sourceLabel: Lovdata, FOR-2022-03-18-410 inserting § 8i (Rapporteringsplikt for kredittinstitusjoner) in FOR-2014-08-15-1076, first list due 20 June 2022 to Utenriksdepartementet; FOR-2024-11-22-2888 part XIX replaced Utenriksdepartementet with Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner from 1 January 2025

titles.en: Report deposits above EUR 100 000 held by Russian nationals, residents and entities to DEKSA every twelve months

summaries.en: A credit institution must give Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner (DEKSA) a list of deposits exceeding EUR 100 000 held by Russian nationals, natural persons residing in Russia or legal persons established in Russia, updated every twelve months, together with information on such deposits held by Russian nationals or residents who obtained Norwegian or EU citizenship or residence through an investor scheme.
